candidate: vLLM per-block FP8 weight-only backbone plus exact-packed BF16 lm_head
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, batch-1 greedy decode, 128 output tokens

precision_contract.backbone: FP8 E4M3, static 128x128 per-block weight scales, BF16 activations
precision_contract.lm_head: losslessly packed BF16; every source weight bit is reconstructed

mechanism: Keep vLLM's scheduler, CUDA graphs, recurrent/attention implementations, and Marlin FP8 weight-only backbone path. Add the exact-packed lm_head because vLLM's online per-block FP8 conversion quantized 164 backbone linear layers but left the tied embedding/output projection in BF16.

performance_qualification.protocol: C-S-S-C process order; six natural prompts; 3 warmups and 10 trials per case; 128 generated tokens; fixed 512 MiB KV cache; max_num_seqs=1; GPU telemetry enabled
performance_qualification.control: exact-packed BF16 lm_head with BF16 backbone
performance_qualification.candidate: exact-packed BF16 lm_head with vLLM fp8_per_block backbone

quality_screen.interpretation: This bounded screen does not detect a statistically significant accuracy change, but it also does not establish quality equivalence. The point estimate is 0.98 percentage points lower and broader tasks are required before production defaulting.

same_quantization_vllm_qualification.protocol: same patched source, C-S-S-C, fp8_per_block on both sides, stock BF16 lm_head versus exact-packed BF16 lm_head
same_quantization_vllm_qualification.interpretation: This isolates a stable custom-kernel contribution beyond the same vLLM quantized baseline. It does not make the FP8 backbone strict-BF16-equivalent.

qualification: Promoted only as an opt-in latency-first candidate for this GPU/model/batch-1 scope. The strict default remains exact-packed BF16. This is neither a global optimum nor proof of SOTA.
reopen_or_production_rules: Run broader reasoning, code, instruction-following, and sampled-generation quality suites before enabling by default.
Repeat randomized BF16/FP8 process order under a locked GPU power mode.
Requalify every checkpoint, GPU architecture, batch size, context distribution, and vLLM version.
Compare against an offline calibrated FP8 checkpoint and other supported quantized vLLM baselines under the same quality target.
